notes: «أبي» is a bare relation (Mu'tamir's father, not named here).
«خالدا الأثبج ابن أخي، صفوان بن محرز»: the nephew clause describes Khalid and is left out; Khalid narrates from Safwan (occurrence 2 of the name).
Jundub speaks the saying; «كنا نحدث أنه أسامة بن زيد» is an unnamed «we» report, not a link (rule 6).
